contentHtml: The application period for PCP (Professional Career Programme) has been extended to March 28th, 2023. PCP can be taken in parallel with a research seminar. Application requirements are here: https://www.econ.keio.ac.jp/en/undergraduate/pcp/application They are looking forward to welcoming eligible students into this all-English economics programme for 3rd and 4th year students.
